## Software

```{r}
etverse <- data.table(
  title = "etverse: Modular R ecosystem for transparent causal inference",
  url = "https://github.com/etverse",
  type = "software",
  journal = "In development",
  publication_date = NA_character_,
  note = paste(
    "Includes: **causatr** (causal effects estimation), **negatr** (negative",
    "control analysis), **matchatr** (matched case-control and case-cohort",
    "study analysis), and **survatr** (survival analysis)."
  )
)
render_talks(etverse)
cat("\n")
render_talks(software)
```
